allocation.noProjects: No projects yet. Add a project to switch skills on for it.
allocation.globalTitle: Your home folder (~/.claude/skills, ~/.agents/skills): every project uses it, including the CLIs run outside Puppeteer.
allocation.globalRemote: Only switchable on the host itself, not from a remote desktop.

globalHint.installed: Linked from your home folder to the library. Click to remove the link.
globalHint.not_installed: Click to link it into your home folder for every project.

hint.installed: Linked to the library. Click to switch off.
hint.drifted: Switched on, but the project folder differs from the library (an edited copy, another link, or nothing there). Click to switch off.
hint.git_managed: The repo commits its own skill of this name. Puppeteer only reads it.
hint.shadowed: Installed, but a skill of the same name in your home folder is the one the agent uses.
hint.not_installed: Click to switch on for this engine in this project.
hint.taken: Your home folder already holds something else under this name (your own skill or another link), or the folder is a symlink. Puppeteer leaves it alone: rename or remove it, or rename the skill.

bulk.hint: Switch several skills on or off in several projects at once, after a preview of the files.
bulk.title: Bulk switch
bulk.previewHint: Pick skills, projects and engines, then Preview to see every file that will be created or removed. Nothing changes before Apply.
bulk.summary: {changes} changes · {create} files to create · {remove} to remove · {skipped} skipped · {unchanged} already as asked
bulk.nothing: Nothing to change: every pick is already as asked.
bulk.switchOnly: only the switch changes, no file

file.remove: Removed (a copy-era folder goes to the backups unless it is unedited)

skip.git_managed: skipped: the repo commits its own skill of this name
skip.occupied: skipped: something that isn't Puppeteer's link is already there (switch the chip by hand to replace it)
skip.source_missing: skipped: the skill's library folder is missing

effective.summary: Skills {engine} loads in this project: {loaded} ({shadowed} hidden).
effective.homeWins: A global skill hides the project's skill of the same name.
effective.bothLoad: Skills of the same name in both folders are both loaded.

originHint.library: Puppeteer's link to the library skill. Switch it on the Allocation tab.
originHint.git_managed: The repo commits this skill. Puppeteer only reads it.
originHint.unmanaged: A skill Puppeteer doesn't manage: your own folder, a copy, or a link elsewhere.

effective.shadowedHint: A global skill of the same name wins: the agent never loads this one.
